lines.text: Jake walked toward a Yellowstone bison for a photo.
Then it lifted its head and stared at him.
Bison are fast, and they hurt visitors who get too close.
Here's the fix. The park asks you to stay at least twenty-five yards from bison and elk,
and one hundred yards from bears and wolves.
He got the shot from a safe distance.
Save this before your Yellowstone trip.
